description: A Sierra-style point-and-click adventure game based on 'The Smallest Ambassador' novel. Play as Pip, a tiny penguin who becomes Earth's first ambassador to alien refugees. Features VGA-style pixel art (320x200), SCUMM-style verb interface, inventory puzzles, and pattern-matching puzzles representing base-7 mathematics.
